evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

claim_under_test: A sixth rotation source appears for Syndra: an option named 'splinters', of kind self_state, attributed to ability slot P.

sources_quoted.supports: Slot P is the innate 'Transcendent'; therefore the splinter mechanic's home slot is P.

sources_quoted.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times. She gains Splinters of Wrath from the following: Dealing two instances of ability damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) Splinters. ... Ranking up an ability with any skill points beyond level 1 grants 5 Splinters, up to 85. Killing a large minion grants 1 Splinter.
sources_quoted.supports: The option is a 0-120 integer stack count named 'Splinters (of Wrath)' -> option name 'splinters'; domain max 120 matches the scenario suffix '_120'.

sources_quoted.quote: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
sources_quoted.supports: At the scenario's pinned value (120) the P slot applies a x1.15 total-AP buff, so the splinter count is a live numeric input to the rotation, not cosmetic.
Kind classification: the splinter stack is a state carried by Syndra herself (self), not a target debuff / item / external source -> kind 'self_state' is the correct classification.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
sources_quoted.supports: Splinters gate the Q second-charge (Q2) source in the rotation.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
sources_quoted.supports: Splinters gate an entire damage component (W bonus true damage) in the rotation.
Independent check of the 12% + 2%/100AP reading: 0.12 x 70 = 8.4 and 0.12 x 190 = 22.8 reproduce the flat Bonus True Damage row exactly at ranks 1 and 5.

sources_quoted.quote: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak ... / Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.
sources_quoted.supports: All five slots read the same splinter counter; it is a shared rotation-level input.

sources_quoted.quote: "gap_summary": "All damage and splinter atom families covered: splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff ..."; "note": "... P = 120-splinter +15% total AP BUFF."
sources_quoted.supports: Cached audit data independently names the option 'splinters', its domain 0-120, and attributes the 120-splinter buff to slot P -- matching the new leaf's name and slot exactly.

sources_quoted.quote: "E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers."
sources_quoted.supports: Confirms 'splinters' is an option (a user/scenario-set input), distinct from the r_spheres option, and that 120 -> 1.15x AP.

sources_quoted.quote: | Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT | ... |
sources_quoted.supports: The rotation block is an exact, fully-sourced computation; every numeric input it consumes is expected to be traceable, so a state that changes the numbers must be enumerated among its sources.

sources_quoted.quote: traces to a wiki/game source. Production attackers use validated named modules;
sources_quoted.supports: Provenance requirement: rotation outputs must trace to their inputs.

independent_computation.method: Materiality test. If the splinter self-state is a genuine source of the rotation, then holding every other input fixed and moving only the splinter count must move the rotation's damage. I evaluate Syndra's full rotation from the cached wiki leveling rows at splinters = 120 (the scenario's pinned state) and at splinters = 0.

fixed_inputs.note: AP and ranks are chosen concretely to make the arithmetic checkable; the conclusion (non-zero delta) is independent of the choice for any AP > 0.

formulas_used.P_transcendence: AP_effective = AP_nominal x 1.15 iff splinters >= 120   [P effects[2]]
formulas_used.W_true: W_magic x (0.12 + 0.02 x AP_effective/100) iff splinters >= 60   [W Transcendent Bonus]
formulas_used.R: spheres x (160 + 0.20 x AP_effective)   [R 'Magic Damage per Sphere' row, rank 3]

independent_computation.delta: +304.668 raw magic/true damage, +9.892% on the rotation total
independent_computation.conclusion: The splinter count is a first-class numeric input to this rotation: at the scenario's pinned value it multiplies total AP by 1.15 (P) and switches on an entire damage component (W true damage), swinging the rotation by ~9.9% at AP 400 and by more at higher AP. A sources list for scenario 'syndra_derived_order_120' that omits it fails to record the input that produced the numbers.

attribution_check.name: 'splinters' -- the wiki resource is 'Splinters of Wrath'; the cached audit records the modelled option under exactly the name 'splinters'.
attribution_check.kind: 'self_state' -- P is targeting=Passive, affects=Self; the counter is a persistent state on Syndra, not a target debuff, item, or rune source.
attribution_check.slot: 'P' -- the counter and its 120-stack capstone are defined in Syndra.abilities.P[0] ('Transcendent'). Attributing it to Q/W/E/R would be wrong: those slots only *read* the counter via their Transcendent Bonus clauses.
attribution_check.index: sources[5] -- appended after the five damage-producing rotation entries (Q, Q2 second charge, W, E, R, per data/champion-audit/batch-6.json modeled slots P/Q/Q2/W/E/R where P contributes no damage entry of its own). A trailing position for the shared self-state is consistent; no evidence in the cached data contradicts the ordering.

counter_hypothesis_considered.hypothesis: The old value (<absent>) was right and the sixth source is spurious -- e.g. P produces no damage and so should not be listed.
counter_hypothesis_considered.rejected_because: The sources list entry is explicitly typed as an *option* ('option splinters (self_state, slot P)'), not a damage entry. P contributes no damage line yet demonstrably scales every other line by 1.15x at 120 stacks; a rotation whose numbers depend on a state that appears nowhere in its sources is unprovenanced. The scenario name pins the state at 120, i.e. exactly the value at which the P capstone fires.

residual_uncertainty: The kind taxonomy label 'self_state' does not appear anywhere under data/ or in docs/math-foundations.md, so it could not be string-matched against a published enumeration; it is judged correct on semantics (affects=Self, persistent stack state). Likewise the exact ordering of sources[0..4] is not recoverable from the cached data alone -- only the membership and the (name, kind, slot) attribution of sources[5] were verified. Neither uncertainty affects the verdict on this leaf's content.
